k: A bell-founder in the ruins of Aurenne remembers his guild's calling.
src: 'A bell-founder in the ruins of Aurenne remembers his guild\'s calling.'

k: An old kite-flyer in Kiteholm remembers the first wing-builders.
src: 'An old kite-flyer in Kiteholm remembers the first wing-builders.'

k: The sexton at the Garden That Remembers keeps the last Mnemonist's name.
src: 'The sexton at the Garden That Remembers keeps the last Mnemonist\'s name.'

k: For the story first. Foes are frailer and hit softer, so battles stay quick and forgiving.
src: 'For the story first. Foes are frailer and hit softer, so battles stay quick and forgiving.'

k: The intended challenge. Learn each foe's weaknesses and Break them; bosses will test your build.
src: 'The intended challenge. Learn each foe\'s weaknesses and Break them; bosses will test your build.'

k: For veterans. Foes are tougher and hit harder; every boss demands a plan.
src: 'For veterans. Foes are tougher and hit harder; every boss demands a plan.'

src: 'Ghost Ray'

src: 'Brinefang Fry'

k: Speckled like forest light.
src: 'Speckled like forest light.'

k: Aurenne's canal carp. They gather when the bells ring.
src: 'Aurenne\'s canal carp. They gather when the bells ring.'

src: 'Whisper Pike'

k: Fishermen say it hums lullabies under the ice.
src: 'Fishermen say it hums lullabies under the ice.'

k: Glass Minnow
src: 'Glass Minnow'

k: You can see its heart beating.
src: 'You can see its heart beating.'

k: Sun Koi
src: 'Sun Koi'

k: Gold scales that stay warm long after dark.
src: 'Gold scales that stay warm long after dark.'

k: Mire Eel
src: 'Mire Eel'

k: Slippery. Smells like the bog. Mirefen loves them.
src: 'Slippery. Smells like the bog. Mirefen loves them.'

k: Bog Lanternfish
src: 'Bog Lanternfish'

k: Its lure glows the same color as a Lantern.

k: Frost Char

k: Caught through the ice at Frosthollow. Monks bless the first of the season.

k: Ash Skate
src: 'Ash Skate'

k: Swims through falling ash as if it were water. Maybe it is now.
src: 'Swims through falling ash as if it were water. Maybe it is now.'

k: Memory Carp
src: 'Memory Carp'

k: When you hold it, you remember something that never happened to you.
src: 'When you hold it, you remember something that never happened to you.'

k: Sunshard Marlin
src: 'Sunshard Marlin'

k: It swallowed a sliver of the broken sun. It glows. It is furious.
src: 'It swallowed a sliver of the broken sun. It glows. It is furious.'

k: Old Gnarlhide
src: 'Old Gnarlhide'

k: the East Fields of Thistledown
src: 'the East Fields of Thistledown'

k: A boar the size of a hay cart has been tearing up the East Fields outside Thistledown. The farmers call him Old Gnarlhide and leave him the south field.
src: 'A boar the size of a hay cart has been tearing up the East Fields outside Thistledown. The farmers call him Old Gnarlhide and leave him the south field.'

k: A boar the size of a hay cart, gray with age, rooting through the stubble. Its tusks are as long as Wren's arm. It lifts its head and looks straight at you.
src: 'A boar the size of a hay cart, gray with age, rooting through the stubble. Its tusks are as long as Wren\'s arm. It lifts its head and looks straight at you.'

k: Old Gnarlhide goes down like a felled oak, and the field is quiet.
src: 'Old Gnarlhide goes down like a felled oak, and the field is quiet.'

k: The Wold Widow
src: 'The Wold Widow'

k: the heart of the Whisperwold
src: 'the heart of the Whisperwold'

k: In the Whisperwold's heart there's a web strung between two oaks, wide as a sail. Whatever spun it is called the Widow, and her brood comes with her.
src: 'In the Whisperwold\'s heart there\'s a web strung between two oaks, wide as a sail. Whatever spun it is called the Widow, and her brood comes with her.'

k: A web between two oaks, wide as a sail, beaded with dew and worse. Something the color of a bruise sits at its center. It has far too many eyes, and all of them open.
src: 'A web between two oaks, wide as a sail, beaded with dew and worse. Something the color of a bruise sits at its center. It has far too many eyes, and all of them open.'

k: The Widow curls up like a burnt leaf. Her web sags and tears in the wind.
src: 'The Widow curls up like a burnt leaf. Her web sags and tears in the wind.'

k: Mother Knot
src: 'Mother Knot'

k: the sewers under Aurenne
src: 'the sewers under Aurenne'

k: The rat-catchers won't go into the deep sewers under Aurenne anymore. They say there's a rat king down there, a hundred rats knotted at the tail, and it eats its own young to heal.
src: 'The rat-catchers won\'t go into the deep sewers under Aurenne anymore. They say there\'s a rat king down there, a hundred rats knotted at the tail, and it eats its own young to heal.'

k: A heap in the dark that squeaks with a hundred voices: rats knotted tail to tail into one great shuddering thing. The middle of it has a face.
src: 'A heap in the dark that squeaks with a hundred voices: rats knotted tail to tail into one great shuddering thing. The middle of it has a face.'

k: Mother Knot comes apart into a hundred fleeing rats. None of them look back.
src: 'Mother Knot comes apart into a hundred fleeing rats. None of them look back.'

k: Glasseye
src: 'Glasseye'

k: the deep dunes of the Sunscar
src: 'the deep dunes of the Sunscar'

k: Pilgrims crossing the Sunscar talk of a basilisk with one eye of clear glass. Look into it and your legs turn to stone, they say. Look away and it breathes fire.
src: 'Pilgrims crossing the Sunscar talk of a basilisk with one eye of clear glass. Look into it and your legs turn to stone, they say. Look away and it breathes fire.'

k: A long, low drake basks on a dune of fused sand. One of its eyes is clear glass with the sun burning in it. The air around it shimmers.
src: 'A long, low drake basks on a dune of fused sand. One of its eyes is clear glass with the sun burning in it. The air around it shimmers.'

k: Glasseye's glass eye cracks across. Then the light goes out of it.
src: 'Glasseye\'s glass eye cracks across. Then the light goes out of it.'

k: Old Belcher
src: 'Old Belcher'

k: the Drownmere in the Mirefen
src: 'the Drownmere in the Mirefen'

k: In the Drownmere there's a toad as big as a cottage. The marsh-folk call him Old Belcher. He sings people to sleep, then sits on them.
src: 'In the Drownmere there\'s a toad as big as a cottage. The marsh-folk call him Old Belcher. He sings people to sleep, then sits on them.'

k: What looked like a mossy hillock in the bog opens two yellow eyes. It is a toad, as big as a cottage. Its throat swells like a bellows.
src: 'What looked like a mossy hillock in the bog opens two yellow eyes. It is a toad, as big as a cottage. Its throat swells like a bellows.'

k: Old Belcher deflates with one long, last croak that echoes across the whole mere.
src: 'Old Belcher deflates with one long, last croak that echoes across the whole mere.'

k: Cinderjaw
src: 'Cinderjaw'

k: the ash of the Drift
src: 'the ash of the Drift'

k: Out on the Drift there's a drake that swims through the ash like a fish through water. Salvagers call it Cinderjaw. The ash catches fire wherever it surfaces.
src: 'Out on the Drift there\'s a drake that swims through the ash like a fish through water. Salvagers call it Cinderjaw. The ash catches fire wherever it surfaces.'

k: The ash heaves and something surfaces: a drake of black slag, embers glowing between its scales. Its jaws drip fire.
src: 'The ash heaves and something surfaces: a drake of black slag, embers glowing between its scales. Its jaws drip fire.'

k: Cinderjaw sinks back into the ash and does not surface again. The embers go gray.
src: 'Cinderjaw sinks back into the ash and does not surface again. The embers go gray.'

k: Hymnal
src: 'Hymnal'

k: the Drowned Choir under ruined Aurenne
src: 'the Drowned Choir under ruined Aurenne'

k: Under the ruins of Aurenne, where the Choir used to sing, an eel as long as a nave has learned the hymns. Those who hear it stop being able to speak.
src: 'Under the ruins of Aurenne, where the Choir used to sing, an eel as long as a nave has learned the hymns. Those who hear it stop being able to speak.'

k: In the flooded choir loft, an eel as long as the nave coils between the pews. When it opens its mouth, it sings in a choirboy's voice.
src: 'In the flooded choir loft, an eel as long as the nave coils between the pews. When it opens its mouth, it sings in a choirboy\'s voice.'

k: Hymnal's last note breaks off in the middle. The loft is silent for the first time in a year.
src: 'Hymnal\'s last note breaks off in the middle. The loft is silent for the first time in a year.'

k: The Scrap King
src: 'The Scrap King'

k: the Boneyard below Corvin's Roost
src: 'the Boneyard below Corvin\'s Roost'

k: In the Boneyard under Corvin's Roost, the scrap has crowned itself a king: a golem that bolts drones together out of junk, then eats them to mend itself.
src: 'In the Boneyard under Corvin\'s Roost, the scrap has crowned itself a king: a golem that bolts drones together out of junk, then eats them to mend itself.'

k: A throne of wrecked engines, and on it a giant of scrap wearing a crown of bent rivets. Little drones buzz around it like flies. It stands up.
src: 'A throne of wrecked engines, and on it a giant of scrap wearing a crown of bent rivets. Little drones buzz around it like flies. It stands up.'

k: The Scrap King comes apart bolt by bolt. The crown rolls to your feet. It's only a cog.
src: 'The Scrap King comes apart bolt by bolt. The crown rolls to your feet. It\'s only a cog.'

k: Grandmother Frost
src: 'Grandmother Frost'

k: The monks of Frosthollow whisper about Grandmother Frost: a white shape on the pass that sings travelers to sleep in the snow, and the wolves come for them after.
src: 'The monks of Frosthollow whisper about Grandmother Frost: a white shape on the pass that sings travelers to sleep in the snow, and the wolves come for them after.'

k: A shape of falling snow in the shape of an old woman, humming. Wolves of white frost sit around her, like grandchildren listening to a story.
src: 'A shape of falling snow in the shape of an old woman, humming. Wolves of white frost sit around her, like grandchildren listening to a story.'

k: Grandmother Frost stops humming. The snow she was made of settles, softly, over nothing.
src: 'Grandmother Frost stops humming. The snow she was made of settles, softly, over nothing.'

k: Neverwake
src: 'Neverwake'

k: the Gloam Rift
src: 'the Gloam Rift'

k: Deep in the Gloam Rift there's an eye that has never closed. Whoever it looks at falls asleep, and some of them never wake.
src: 'Deep in the Gloam Rift there\'s an eye that has never closed. Whoever it looks at falls asleep, and some of them never wake.'

k: An eye as tall as a door hangs in the dark of the Rift, unblinking. You feel very, very tired.
src: 'An eye as tall as a door hangs in the dark of the Rift, unblinking. You feel very, very tired.'

k: Neverwake shuts. For the first time, perhaps ever, it sleeps.
src: 'Neverwake shuts. For the first time, perhaps ever, it sleeps.'
